an9.14:11.3: When you were asked what is their origin, you answered ‘contact is their origin’.
an9.14:11.4: When you were asked what is their meeting place, you answered ‘feeling is their meeting place’.
an9.14:11.5: When you were asked what is their chief, you answered ‘immersion is their chief’.
an9.14:11.6: When you were asked what is their ruler, you answered ‘mindfulness is their ruler’.
an9.14:11.7: When you were asked what is their overseer, you answered ‘wisdom is their overseer’.
an9.14:11.8: When you were asked what is their core, you answered ‘freedom is their core’.
